decision: All data must be real. Missing data is flagged, never filled with an estimate or placeholder unless Michelle states the assumption.
rationale: Prevents silent assumptions reaching client-facing figures.

decision: 1 m3 of sludge = 1,000 kg (density 1.0 t/m3). Applied to sludge_requested_t / sludge_actual_t.
rationale: Every source document records sludge in m3; columns are tonnes. Oily sludge is slightly less dense than water so 1.0 mildly overstates mass - stated uniform assumption, not a measurement.

decision: Live carbon computes on SEFR (NEA-sourced) factors: waste general 0.1115 tCO2e/t, avoided 0.1115. Exact key match, no regex fallback ranges.
rationale: SEFR is the official SG registry; previous 0.35 WtE was ~3x overstated.

decision: Domestic waste (Cat C) uses the SEFR paper/cardboard incineration factor 1.5305 as representative material.
rationale: Domestic waste is mixed; paper/cardboard chosen as representative.

decision: Sludge routed to GreenTec Energy remains in the RECOVERED bucket.
rationale: NEA national statistics include fuel recovery at dedicated facilities inside Total Recycled; GreenTec is an NEA-licensed TIW collector whose core business is waste-oil recovery.

decision: Avoided = avoided incineration only, at 0.1115 tCO2e per diverted tonne. Material-substitution credits (paper 0.9 / plastics 1.1 / metals 1.5) are NOT used.
rationale: Conservative construct; substitution credits would need SEFR/WARM verification first.

decision: Everything handed to GreenTec or Asia Recycling counts as recovered. Recovery is defined by confirmed disposal ROUTE to a licensed recovery facility, not by downstream yield.
rationale: Stated methodology decision; facility yield data not collected. Route-vs-yield question put to ISO expert (Q5).

decision: Where no weighbridge weight exists, volume converts at US EPA Volume-to-Weight (Apr 2016) per-category loose densities. Actual SEF/weighbridge weight is used when recorded.
rationale: No Singapore density factor exists (NEA, GWC CoP, SEFR, EMA, IMO all checked). EPA is a stated US proxy pending the local weighing exercise.
standard_hook: NEA M&R wet-weight expectation; ISO Annex C
affects: All tonnage and carbon when unweighed (currently 100 percent)

decision: Oily rags use the SEFR textile incineration factor 1.4791, replacing the 0.1115 proxy.
rationale: SEFR free set carries the full 11-category list including textile.

decision: Recovery rate is computed BY VOLUME (m3 ratio). Diversion tonnes are BY MASS. Basis now stated on both surfaces (18 Aug).
rationale: Volume ratio carries no density assumption and is exact; mass depends on EPA proxy densities.

decision: Transport of waste to the disposal facility is EXCLUDED from Cat 5 / Cat 4.3. Treatment only.
rationale: GHG Protocol makes transport optional in Cat 5; ISO Annex B.5.4(a) allows Cat 4 or Cat 3 but requires the choice to be stated. Disclosure wording pending expert (Q9).

decision: Recovered tonnage (Cat A, D, I, sludge) carries a ZERO emission factor. Only disposal is charged.
rationale: Cut-off style allocation. ISO B.5.4(a) lists recycling as a treatment with emissions; SEFR publishes no recycling factors. Documented here per s6.2; acceptability + factor source put to expert (Q5b).

decision: Biogenic/fossil/inert split is a volume-apportioned disclosure of the SAME blended cat5 total; headline cannot move by construction.
rationale: KNOWN GAP 18 Aug: ISO 5.2.4 + Annex D require gas-level separation; a mass apportionment of blended CO2e does not satisfy it. Rebuild from IPCC Vol 5 Ch 5 parameters pending expert (Q1/Q2).

decision: The report engine resolves emission factors by (key, reporting period): the factor whose valid_from/valid_to window covers the reporting month is used; among several, the latest valid_from wins. A month before any factor was valid falls back to the earliest row and the output is flagged factor_vintage_fallback=true. A missing key fails loud (factor_missing), never guesses.
rationale: ISO 14064-1 Annex E (normative) requires the grid factor from the emissions year being reported; selecting latest is non-conformant. Deployed ahead of the EMA 2025 GEF-OM publication (due Oct-Nov 2026) so the new value is an insert, not a scramble. Output verified byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (single factor vintage currently loaded).
standard_hook: ISO 14064-1 Annex E; 5 Aug 2026 pinned-key incident
affects: All carbon figures on all client surfaces
